purpose: High-appearance and ethereal young-adult portraits for the existing gender/age/role pool. Classification tags are art metadata for a future appearance attribute, not runtime gameplay rules.
source_policy: Generated original PNGs copied unchanged; no image postprocessing.
allocation: Current pool discovery still uses gender, age band and role prefix. appearance and bearing tags are documentation only; the future attribute will need to consume or map them explicitly.
